name: semantika
description: Retrieve brand visibility metrics, AI-engine breakdowns, monitored prompts, recommended actions, action details, and GEO reports from the user's authorized Semantika workspace.

interface.longDescription: Semantika helps teams understand how brands appear in AI-generated answers. Use this integration to retrieve available brand lists, visibility metrics, engine breakdowns, monitored prompts, recommended actions, action details, and the latest GEO report. Results are limited to the workspaces and data authorized by the signed-in user. Available capabilities depend on the tools exposed by the connected Semantika MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Show my available Semantika brands and workspaces.
Summarize visibility for my first available brand.
List my recommended GEO actions and explain the highest-priority one.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: brand visibility, monitored prompts, recommended actions, and GEO reports via the Semantika MCP server.
